content: Betadine is the brand name for Purdue Pharma's line of povidone-iodine (PVP-I) topical antiseptics that are available for consumer use. Betadine products, like most PVP-I formulations, are offered in two primary forms: 1. Solution: This is a 10% povidone-iodine solution in water. It is sold over-the-counter (OTC) and is commonly used for cleaning minor wounds. In medical settings, it is utilized to prepare a patient’s skin prior to surgical procedures. 2. Surgical Scrub: This formulation is a combination of povidone-iodine and a detergent. It is also sold OTC and serves as a skin cleanser and disinfectant hand wash. It is specifically used for cleaning hands before surgery and other aseptic procedures.
